picks.title: chat: configure GitHub Environments rollout
picks.summary: GitHub Environments becomes available on Stable through a default-on, rollout-controlled preview setting, and remotely initiated work uses the host's credentials by default; sharing still requires explicit opt-in.
picks.author: roblourens

picks.title: chat: add configurable GPT Live session awareness
picks.summary: OpenAI BYOK Voice Mode now receives session titles, summaries and recent active-chat turns by default to answer status questions; disable `agents.voice.sessionAwareness` and reconnect to stop sharing that context.
picks.author: meganrogge

picks.title: Parent the ConPTY console window to the VS Code window
picks.summary: Windows terminal-app dialogs now appear in front of VS Code by default, but modal dialogs block the editor and a known issue can leave it disabled if the dialog's process dies.
picks.author: anthonykim1

picks.title: agentHost: bump Copilot SDK to 1.0.26
picks.summary: Agent Host no longer enables SDK-owned session export through `chat.sessionSync.enabled`, while the extension exporter remains unchanged; the bundled runtime also enables saving generated images to disk by default.
picks.author: roblourens

picks.title: chat: share customization on/off state across windows and profiles
picks.summary: MCP server, plugin and Agent Host tool-set switches now apply across profiles on the same machine, with disabled values winning during migration instead of sessions silently re-enabling tools in another window.
picks.author: vritant24

picks.title: sessions: enable new session composer layout by default in Insiders
picks.summary: Insiders and development builds now use the new Agents-window session composer layout by default, changing the session-creation interface while Stable and explicit user overrides remain unchanged.
picks.author: meganrogge

picks.title: sessions: add agent tools to read and organize the Sessions list
picks.summary: Agents-window assistants gain default-on tools to inspect session lists and change groups, ordering, filters and archive placement, controlled by `sessions.list.agentTools.enabled`.
picks.author: benibenj

picks.title: chat: fix voice context, question narration, and steering
picks.summary: Voice requests during ongoing work now steer that work by default rather than queueing, while clarification handoffs retain context and multi-question forms ask for one answer at a time.
picks.author: meganrogge

picks.title: agentHost: set up Computer Use one permission at a time
picks.summary: With Computer Use enabled on macOS, setup guides one permission at a time and closes when the agent stops waiting, removing the standalone Set Up Computer Use command and the Not Now and Check Again buttons.
picks.author: Giuspepe

picks.title: mcp: align policy matching and gallery command admission
picks.summary: Managed MCP command and URL allow rules now take precedence over name-only allowances for the same transport, so a matching server name alone may no longer permit installation or startup.
picks.author: connor4312
